entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by a UE for initial registration for 5GS services, including emergency services, SNPN onboarding, and disaster roaming services.

entities.name: 5GS registration type IE
entities.description: Information element that indicates the type of registration being performed by the UE.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to initiate the registration procedure.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the network in response to a registration request.

entities.name: MUSIM UE emergency registration condition
entities.description: Condition where a MUSIM UE initiates registration with emergency registration type.

entities.name: Network feature restrictions
entities.description: Network shall not indicate support for N1 NAS signalling connection release, paging indication for voice services, reject paging request, or paging restriction in REGISTRATION ACCEPT.

relations.description: The initial registration procedure involves sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
The REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the 5GS registration type IE.
When a MUSIM UE performs emergency registration, the network shall apply feature restrictions in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
The REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the network feature restrictions when the condition is met.
